limitations: All budgets are process-local and non-durable; share the same task object, not just an ID.
Capacity reservations are conservative and may reject a small prompt with a large window; failed unknown attempts retain reservations.
Model token-cost ceiling uses reliable upper rates; registry estimates are not invoices. External/native service fees are excluded; hard cost limits reject native tools.
All-zero built-in transport usage is conservatively unknown because legacy converters normalize absent wire usage to zeros; original public responses/events unchanged.
Cancellation cannot withdraw emitted text or guarantee a remote operation stopped; late outcomes remain on original task.
Helpers bypass main Agent/context hooks and events, inherit restrictive data policy and receive only explicitly selected text. Schema validation cannot prove truth.
Rollover remains between executions and its existing formatter is not a lossless native/multimodal export; automatic structured compaction belongs to Stage 07.
No main-model switching, distributed/native state migration or new context framework.
Observed Google exact-text failures are retained; passing final functional samples do not establish a model reliability rate or comparative quality/cost savings.
